body.note: Section 39.7: route after the 39.2-39.6 chapters (w03-p03-055 to w03-p03-059); this chapter cross-references labels of 055, 056 and 059.

sources_read_online.version: Kolaitis manuscript dated 1 August 2003 (not the 2007 Springer version of record); re-fetched 13 October 2026, md5 cc02cc606380b8cf3667b9a4a805978d

proposed_decisions: Bib keys Kolaitis2003ExpressivePowerManuscript and Gradel2007FMTChapter3AuthorPDF are copied verbatim from the w03-p03-056 intake; merge each to one entry. w03-p03-059 cites the same Graedel PDF as Graedel2007FMTDC; the finalizer may unify the keys.
IFP is defined here (def:p03-w03-p03-060-ifp); no sibling chapter read defines it.

w03-p03-061 (section 39.8) contains thm:p03-w03-p03-061-datalog (k-Datalog in EL^k for programs) and thm:p03-w03-p03-061-substitution, overlapping thm:p03-w03-p03-060-kdatalog and thm:p03-w03-p03-060-variable-substitution, and a second existential-game treatment overlapping thm:p03-w03-p03-060-existential-game. Lead to decide which chapter keeps which statement; 39.7's assessment required the system form (Kolaitis Thm. 8.2) here.
Kolaitis Thm. 8.2 second item prints EFO^k for lfp components; stated here with EL^k_infty-omega and the printed reading refuted (thm:p03-w03-p03-060-tc-not-fo).
Kolaitis Prop. 6.21 single-conjunction form is false for multi-rule programs (thm:p03-w03-p03-060-single-conjunction); the theorem uses finite disjunctions.
routing_note: Neither this chapter nor siblings w03-p03-055/056/059 is input by handbook/parts/p03.tex or handbook/annex/p03.tex; the L^k definitions and k-pebble characterization this chapter links to (def:p03-w03-p03-056-grammar, thm:p03-w03-p03-056-eternal, thm:p03-w03-p03-055-pebble) reach the reader only when those chapters are routed before this one (lead action).
open_items: Hard direction of Abiteboul-Vianu: not proved; statement owned by w03-p03-059 (cited=).
Kreutzer IFP=LFP on infinite structures: cited=.
Kolaitis p. 54 remarks (transfinite stages of positive formulas in L^k; LFP in L^omega on bounded-cardinality classes): reported, not proved.
Nested LFP/IFP/PFP formulas: only the generous variable bound is proved.
